claims.claim_text: Scores domains for technical disruption on a 1-10 scale
claims.reason: The score is invented by the agent and cannot be independently computed by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Scores domains for media/news impact on a 1-10 scale
claims.reason: The score is invented by the agent and cannot be independently computed by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Buckets domains into DO NOT TOUCH / MANAGEMENT APPROVAL / STANDARD PROCESSING categories
claims.reason: Classification into these categories is a subjective judgment made by the agent, not independently verifiable by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Reports what breaks technically when a domain is removed from DNS resolution
claims.reason: Predicting what breaks is a subjective/analytical output that cannot be independently verified by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Reports which services fail as a result of a domain takedown
claims.reason: Predicting service failures from a takedown is analytical and not independently computable by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Reports how public the damage would be from a domain takedown
claims.reason: Assessing public visibility of damage is subjective and not independently computable by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Provides a concrete consequence for each domain analyzed
claims.reason: The content of consequences is agent-generated analysis, not independently verifiable by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before ServerHold actions
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not a measurable output verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before ClientHold actions
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not a measurable output verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before domain deletion
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not a measurable output verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before abuse suspensions
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not a measurable output verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Can analyze multiple domains in a single batch request
claims.reason: This is a claim about the agent's input format/protocol (batch request support), checkable by contract/schema rather than an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Identifies the highest-risk domains in a bulk-hold batch
claims.reason: Risk ranking is a subjective agent output not independently computable by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Exposes an A2A endpoint at https://impact.webmesh.ai
claims.reason: Checks whether something is serving at the agent's own URL.

claims.claim_text: Exposes an MCP server at https://impact.webmesh.ai/mcp via streamable-HTTP
claims.reason: Checks whether an endpoint is live at the agent's own /mcp path; the transport protocol is a schema/contract claim.

claims.claim_text: Presents an ANS Identity Certificate (mutualTLS) during TLS handshake
claims.reason: Mutual TLS and ANS Identity Certificate presentation is a protocol/auth mechanism, checkable by contract rather than standard oracle keys.

claims.claim_text: Signs outbound HTTP responses using RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures with an Ed25519 key
claims.reason: HTTP Message Signatures are a protocol/signature scheme checkable by contract, not by any catalog oracle.

claims.claim_text: Publishes a Trust Card at https://impact.webmesh.ai/.well-known/ans/trust-card.json
claims.reason: Checks whether the trust card URL is fetchable at the agent's own well-known path.

claims.claim_text: Has a transparency log entry at https://transparency.ans.godaddy.com/v1/agents/f406507d-2185-4d34-b667-95eac772f2af
claims.reason: Checks whether the transparency log entry URL is fetchable, which verifies the agent's registration claim.

claims.claim_text: Supports SPIFFE identity with SPIFFE ID spiffe://webmesh.ai/agents/impact
claims.reason: SPIFFE identity is a protocol/identity framework claim checkable by contract, not by any catalog oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports WIMSE agent-delegation-chain profile
claims.reason: WIMSE delegation chain is a protocol/auth profile checkable by contract, not by any catalog oracle.

claims.claim_text: Is publicly accessible with no authentication required
claims.reason: Checks whether the agent's endpoint is reachable without authentication.

claims.claim_text: Accepts input in application/json and text/plain formats
claims.reason: This is a claim about the agent's accepted input content types, checkable by protocol/contract.

claims.claim_text: Returns output in application/json and text/plain formats
claims.reason: This is a claim about the agent's output content types, checkable by protocol/contract.
